name: Drill Block Simulator!
desc:
Welcome to Drill Block Simulator! 🚨
🗓️ Updates every Saturday at 1PM UTC!

⛽  Pump to gain power!
🗻 Explore mines & collect blocks!
🐾 Make money & hatch pets!
🌏 Discover new worlds and find exciting surprises!

Leave a like and follow the game if you enjoy it! 👍

The game is in BETA testing phase so please be patient and report any bugs to the server below! 🐞
